what: Novo Nordisk is the Danish maker of Ozempic and Wegovy, the GLP-1 drugs for diabetes and obesity, and one of the world's largest insulin producers.
customers: People with diabetes or obesity, through pharmacies, insurers and health systems.
moat: A century of expertise in diabetes, large-scale manufacturing of injectable drugs and patents on semaglutide.
risks: Competition from Lilly and compounded copies
opportunities: Gross margin of 81% with return on invested capital of 31%
A dividend yield around 4.6% after the share price fall
An oral version of its weight-loss medicine would reach patients unwilling to inject
watch: Wegovy and Ozempic prescription share against Eli Lilly.
